mapper.select: /** * selectMnthySchdlRegModAsgnNocs : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MnthySchdlRegInfoMngMapper : 월별 일정등록정보 관리 수정 화면 할당 댓글 조회 */ SELECT AA.NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS AS NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS /** 게시판할당건수 **/ , AA.CMNT_ASGN_NOCS AS CMNT_ASGN_NOCS /** 댓글할당건수 **/ FROM AYC170 AA /** 월별게시판댓글할당 **/ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.RLVT_YM = #{YEAR_MONTH} AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}

/** * selectChcMnthySchdlList : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MnthySchdlRegInfoMngMapper : 선택한 월별 일정등록정보 관리 조회 */ SELECT AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO /** 사업계획관리번호 **/ , AA.CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM /** 기준연월 **/ , substr(AA.BGNG_HR, 0, 2) AS BGNG_HR /** 시작시간_시간 **/ , substr(AA.BGNG_HR, 4, 2) AS BGNG_MIN /** 시작시간_분 **/ , substr(AA.END_HR, 0, 2) AS END_HR /** 종료시간_시간 **/ , substr(AA.END_HR, 4, 2) AS END_MIN /** 종료시간_분 **/ , AA.TOT_HR AS TOT_HR /** 집계시간 **/ , AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD /** 업무유형기관번호 **/ , AA.MBR_NOCS AS MBR_NOCS /** 회원건수 **/ FROM AYC110 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.CRTR_YM = #{YEAR_MONTH} AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} ORDER BY AA.CRTR_YM, AA.BGNG_HR

/** * selectChcMnthySchdlAsgnInfo : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MnthySchdlRegInfoMngMapper : 선택한 월별 일정등록정보 관리 할당량 조회 */ SELECT AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 일련번호 */ , AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD /* 부서코드 */ , AA.RLVT_YM AS YEAR_MONTH /* 조회연월 */ , AA.NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS AS NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS /** 게시판할당건수 **/ , AA.CMNT_ASGN_NOCS AS CMNT_ASGN_NOCS /** 댓글할당건수 **/ FROM AYC170 AA /** 월별게시판댓글할당 **/ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.RLVT_YM = #{YEAR_MONTH} AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
mapper.delete: /** * deleteChcMnthySchdlList : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.MnthySchdlRegInfoMngMapper : 선택한 월별 일정등록정보 관리 삭제 */ DELETE FROM AYC110 WHERE 1=1 AND BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = #{BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO}
